description: Get a bounded structural page of the active sequence (50 clips by default; follow pagination.nextOffset): all track counts, paged clips with positions, gaps, and clip metadata. Essential for understanding timeline state before making edits.

clip_limit.description: Page size (default: 50, maximum: 200). Payload budget may shorten a page. Inspect nextOffset.

clip_offset.description: Offset into matching clips (matching gaps for get_timeline_gaps), video before audio (default: 0).

end_seconds.description: Optional exclusive window end; must exceed start_seconds.

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID. Uses active sequence if omitted.

start_seconds.description: Optional inclusive window start; returns overlapping items.

track_index.description: Optional zero-based track index within each selected type.

track_type.description: Track type to page (default: both). Track counts remain available.

name: get_sequence_structure

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Get Sequence Structure
